about.title: About
paragraphs: I am Omar Abdelr7eem, a creative technologist focused on building digital products and systems where AI, design, and software development meet.
I approach problems as complete systems: understand the problem and the people first, shape the experience, then build the solution and automate what can be improved.
My work focuses on AI and automation, supported by a strong interest in UI/UX design and software development.

principles.title: Systems over screens
principles.text: I don't treat the interface as an isolated layer. I think about the complete experience, system, and user flow.

principles.title: Design with purpose
principles.text: Visual quality matters, but clarity, usability, accessibility, and performance matter more than decoration alone.

principles.title: Automate the repeatable
principles.text: When a task keeps repeating, it can often become an automated workflow that saves time and reduces manual effort.

journey.title: Journey
journey.intro: A continuous journey from design and development to building intelligent systems.
journey.note: Each stage added a new way of understanding problems and building solutions.

steps.label: The Beginning
steps.title: Exploring Technology & Design
steps.text: I started by exploring how digital products are built and how technology and design can come together to create better experiences.

steps.label: Design
steps.title: Learning to Think Through the Experience
steps.text: My focus expanded from simply creating interfaces to understanding users, flows, visual systems, interaction, and the details that shape a product experience.

steps.label: Building
steps.title: Building Products & Systems
steps.text: I moved beyond interfaces into building real digital products and systems that connect the experience with data, logic, and integrations.

steps.label: AI
steps.title: Automation & Intelligent Systems
steps.text: AI and automation became a core part of how I approach digital solutions, focusing on reducing repetitive work and turning processes into smarter systems.

work.title: Selected Work

items.title: LUMASUPPLY
items.description: A website for an electrical and lighting store, featuring LED and traditional bulbs, ceiling lights, and accessories. It also offers practical guidance to help visitors choose products and ask about details and availability.

items.title: Noire
items.description: An editorial showcase for four selected fragrances, featuring an interactive 3D bottle visitors can explore and turn. Browse the collection with search and filters for brand, audience, price, and scent family. This is a visual demo, with no checkout.
